cases.request: A performer hangs sideways from an aerial hoop, one knee hooked over its upper rim, the other leg reaching down, torso twisted toward the viewer. Show all limb contacts.
A goalkeeper dives left with both hands reaching for a ball just above the grass, body airborne, goal behind.
A paramedic kneels beside a seated patient, holding a stethoscope to the patient's back while checking the watch on their own wrist.

A seated craftsperson centers wet clay on a spinning pottery wheel with both palms. Feet supported on the floor, cotton apron over their lap, eye-level front three-quarter medium-full view inside a ceramics workshop.
Two dancers counterbalance while holding one hand, leaning in opposite directions, both feet grounded.
Two athletes practice a controlled grappling throw on a mat; one grips the other's sleeve and rotates their hips underneath, partner balanced over the hip.
A mechanic braces a wheel hub with one hand while tightening its bolt with a torque wrench in the other, car raised on a lift.
A cook folds dumpling dough around filling with both thumbs and index fingers, half-folded dumpling above a floured board.
A climber reaches across an overhang, left toe and right heel hooked on separate holds, one arm locked off while the other reaches a chalked edge.
A stagehand pulls a counterweight rope to raise a curtain while another guides its bottom edge clear of a prop table.
A comedian slips on a rolling ball while keeping a tray level; one foot airborne, the other contacting the ball, torso pitching backward.
Two workers tilt a large glass pane through a narrow doorway, each supporting one lower corner, pane diagonal with its upper edge clear of the frame.
Two hands tie a bowline around a pole; working end passes through the loop, around the standing line, back into the loop.
A guard holds a sign reading "NO ENTRY". No hats. Outfit can change.
cases.rules: no hats; outfit can change; sign must say "NO ENTRY"

cases.request: Take only identity from <image1> and motion from <video1>. The person turns, kneels, then picks up a box in a plain room. Do not transfer source wardrobe, environment or audio.

action: turn then kneel then pick up

cases.request: Two dancers exchange positions while rotating around each other, then one lifts the other as the camera circles them.
<shot1> 0-4s Two people counterbalance holding one hand. Person A says "No, don't stop—go!" <shot2> 4-10s They release hands and recover balance.

Three conservators restore a large painting in a studio. The first supports the stretcher at its left lower corner, the second applies a small brush to a damaged patch near the right edge, and the third holds a raking light above the canvas. All three people and their hands fit inside the frame. A stool is behind the first conservator, not between them and the painting. The canvas faces the camera at an oblique angle, its texture and repair patch visible. Render distinct linen, wooden stretcher and metal lamp materials. Cool window light complements the warmer raking light. Keep brush contact visible; do not replace restoration with a posed group portrait.

constraint: all hands and people in frame
